title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Traffic - UnplannedIncident
description: Unplanned traffic incident in a city (edinttrafico:UnplannedIncident, subclass of edinttrafico:Incident and geosparql:Feature). No properties of its own beyond those inherited from Incident.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'UnplannedIncident'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

incidentInSection.description: Relationship. The StreetSection where the incident takes place (edinttrafico:incidentInSection).

incidentType.description: Relationship. Type of incident. The source ontology does not publish a controlled vocabulary for this yet; kept as a generic Relationship.

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The (expected) start date and time of the incident (schema:startDate). No formal rdfs:domain declared in the source; included per the property's own comment ('of an incident').

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The end date and time of the incident (schema:endDate). Same no-formal-domain situation as startDate.

incidentAttachment.description: Property. A document where more information about the incident can be found (edinttrafico:incidentAttachment).

numDirections.description: Property. Number of directions of traffic affected (edinttrafico:numDirections).
